title: roadmap-tags/1
description: The controlled tag vocabulary, roadmap/tags.yaml (CONVENTIONS section 2; docs/briefs/architecture/roadmap-brief3.md T2). Authored; Joe owns the values. A tag on a node is either free (no colon, never checked) or namespaced, `namespace:value`, and a namespaced tag must name a namespace and a value listed here. Each value may carry a display colour as #rrggbb, or null for none; the colour is shown by the viewer's Colour by control and never carries meaning alone. Names are lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
